modalities.evidence: behavioural ratings of the same stimuli on valence, arousal, and dominance

output.population: 99 adults grouped by UCLA Loneliness Scale (UCLA-LS) score into Lonely (n = 36) and Non-Lonely (n = 63), with demographics and self-report questionnaires
output.summary: Sixty-four-channel EEG during a roving oddball task with emotional face stimuli, plus behavioural valence, arousal and dominance ratings, in adults grouped as Lonely or Non-Lonely by UCLA Loneliness Scale score, with questionnaire measures.
